notes: Repeated revocation is deterministic and safe
Repository support exists for suspending/closing accounts by revoking all sessions; routes are out of scope
operations: revoke all other sessions for account

rotation: Replacement session and old-session revocation occur atomically
Replacement receives a new unique token hash
Exactly one concurrent rotation may succeed
Rotation without reauthentication preserves created_at and authenticated_at
Ordinary rotation may extend idle expiry from the rotation time without extending absolute expiry
semantics: Opaque server-side sessions for future authenticated web and mobile clients
Do not imply membership, payment, local verification, civic entitlement, or Stripe state
Creation requires active account, verified primary email, at least one active passkey, and linked civic actor
Setup grants and recovery grants cannot create sessions
Ordinary activity may extend idle_expires_at but never absolute_expires_at or authenticated_at
accountSessions.storage: token_hash only; raw session tokens never stored

semantics: Persistent atomic counters for ceremony-specific abuse controls
No Redis and no live enforcement middleware in this slice
Hashing/normalization belongs to future ceremony adapters
ceremonyRateLimits.storage: subject_hash only; raw email, IP, credential id, and tokens never stored

description: Architecture contract for ceremony data and session foundation only. No live authentication routes, cookies, CSRF, JWTs, email delivery, or WebAuthn runtime are implemented in this slice.

domainSeparation.accountIdentity: Account shell, verified email, passkeys, challenges, recovery grants
domainSeparation.authenticatedSession: Opaque server-side account_sessions; not membership or civic entitlement
domainSeparation.authenticationCeremony: Challenges, setup grants, WebAuthn challenge records, rate limits
domainSeparation.civicActor: Local civic participation identity; optionally linked 1:1 to an account

notes: Future web clients may use HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookies binding an opaque session identifier
Cookies are not implemented in this slice
CSRF protections for cookie-authenticated mutating routes are future work
Staging, development, and production credentials must remain isolated
Temporary Railway, preview, GitHub Pages, or other temporary domains must never register production credentials
No RP ID or origin runtime configuration is shipped in this slice

grantVersusSessionDistinction.accountSession: Opaque authenticated session after eligible active account authentication
grantVersusSessionDistinction.recoveryGrant: Restricted recovery authority; revokes sessions; does not create a normal session
grantVersusSessionDistinction.setupGrant: Restricted setup authority before first passkey; not authenticated access

semantics: Restricted pre-authentication authority after email verification and before first passkey registration
Cannot create a session without completed passkey registration
Active only when unconsumed, unrevoked, unexpired, and account status is pending_passkey
setupGrants.storage: token_hash only; raw tokens never stored
